title: Local-to-global finiteness of low local-cohomology modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof removes zero-degree torsion and inducts using a regular element. It proves finiteness of the associated-prime set of the potentially nonfinite local-cohomology modules, then assembles local annihilator exponents into a uniform global exponent. This is a genuine finiteness theorem, not ordinary localization of a finite module.
